Use these guidelines when selecting a laptop for your academic work at DU. **Minimum Specifications** apply to students who plan to bring an existing laptop to campus rather than purchasing a new one. These specs represent the lowest acceptable performance level for academic use but may face limitations regarding the systems and applications DU requires. **Recommended Specifications** are intended for students purchasing a new laptop and seeking guidance on what to buy. ### Important Notes **Netbooks**, **Chromebooks**, **Tablets**, and **Other Low Cost Devices** designed for simple web browsing and basic tasks are not recommended as they are known to not meet the needs of most DU Students. **Program-Specific Requirements**: some academic programs require or strongly recommend a specific operating system or hardware configuration. For software and instructions please visit the [Student Resources page](https://www.du.edu/it/student-resources). | | **Cloud Storage/Document Backup** | University students are provided with free OneDrive storage that IT@DU highly recommends they use to backup locally stored course related files. | | **Onboard AI and NPUs** | Neural Processing Units (NPUs) are dedicated AI accelerators now appearing in many new computers. Their performance is measured in **TOPS** (trillions of operations per second), a metric you’ll often see listed when comparing devices.
IT@DU does not currently require NPU equipped devices. However, some emerging tools — including **Microsoft Copilot+** features and certain **AI enhanced Adobe workflows** — perform best on systems with around **40–48 TOPS** of NPU performance. | | **Graphics Cards and VRAM** | Please see [Program Specific Laptop Requirements](https://www.du.edu/it/support/how-to/students/laptops/program-specific) | ### **Recommended Accessories** - **USB Memory Storage Devices:** Strongly recommended for their ease of use and ability to encrypt contents in case of lost or stolen property. - **External Webcam**: Strongly recommended if your computer does not have an integrated or functioning webcam for online learning. - **Headset/Headphones with Microphone**: Strongly recommended for optimal videoconferencing performance as clarity of speech is improved and background noise is minimized. ### **Optional Accessories** - **Multiport Adapter**: specific to your device to both HDMI and USB 3.0 - This will aid in the connection to technology resources in Huddle Rooms, Group Study Rooms, and Classrooms.
